title: The Landmine
description: This mod added a enchantment for minecraft spear, Inspired by the spike mines in Battlefield 5.
body:
# The-Landmine

## Why did I make it

It mainly happened when the author was playing Battlefield 5 and suddenly had a flash of inspiration, creating a complete joke mod.

So I not recommned it in normal surival archives.

It is a works used for joking around. :)

## How to play it.
In Battlefield 5, how you use mines is how you play.

If you haven`t play Battlefield 5, you can use called `landmine` enchantment for your spear, Keep your spear in a charging posture and stab at other creatures to make it explode.
